mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(j.amount), 0) FROM fin_cash_journal j WHERE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.direction = 'in' THEN a.amount ELSE -a.amount END), 0) FROM fin_cash_account_adjustment a WHERE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT j.id FROM fin_cash_journal j WHERE UNION ALL SELECT a.id FROM fin_cash_account_adjustment a WHERE ) ledger_count

SELECT ledger.* FROM ( SELECT j.id AS source_id, 'receipt' AS source_type, j.receipt_date AS business_date, COALESCE(j.receipt_time, j.create_time) AS business_time, j.amount AS inflow_amount, 0.00 AS outflow_amount, j.receipt_no AS reference_no, j.payer_name AS counterparty, COALESCE(j.summary, j.remark) AS summary, CONCAT(j.record_status, '/', j.review_status) AS status, j.create_by AS operator_id, j.owner_name AS operator_name, NULL AS reversal_of_id FROM fin_cash_journal j WHERE UNION ALL SELECT a.id AS source_id, 'adjustment' AS source_type, a.adjustment_date AS business_date, a.adjustment_time AS business_time, CASE WHEN a.direction = 'in' THEN a.amount ELSE 0.00 END AS inflow_amount, CASE WHEN a.direction = 'out' THEN a.amount ELSE 0.00 END AS outflow_amount, a.adjustment_no AS reference_no, a.adjustment_type AS counterparty, a.reason AS summary, a.status AS status, a.operator_id AS operator_id, a.operator_name AS operator_name, a.reversal_of_id AS reversal_of_id FROM fin_cash_account_adjustment a WHERE ) ledger ORDER BY ledger.business_date DESC, ledger.business_time DESC, ledger.source_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
